rows.description: The Doves Play Barn is an activity play barn at Heaven Farm, Furner’s Green, near Uckfield. Built from sustainable wood, it has hidden spaces, rope bridges, slides and a toddler-safe area, plus a café, inflatables and parties. Its website says it is open seven days a week, 9am to 5pm. Checked against the venue’s website on 25 October 2026.

rows.description:
Washbrooks Family Farm is a soft play centre based in Brighton, East Sussex. Highly rated and very popular — a welcoming play venue that offers indoor facilities for children of varying ages in a safe and supervised environment.

The climbing structures are incredible with air bouncing pockets to jump on.

To get the most out of a visit to Washbrooks Family Farm, check their current session times and prices online before you go — these are updated regularly.
